title: Meadows Valley School District
description: The Meadows Valley School District strives to prepare all students for life's demands, adventures, and challenges. While the district offers educational services designed to foster student growth and development, its negligence in security has exposed its staff and students to the compromise of personal information. Therefore, we are providing you with confidential district documents, including student education records, protected health information, employee personnel files, Social Security numbers, payment card information, student lists, residential addresses, and phone numbers.
